note: Node checkWorkflow (ci/application/workflow-check.ts + domain/workflow-rules.ts) with the yaml package of the server checkout at d1c9093. result = {ok:true} or {ok:false, rule} with rule in invalid_yaml | forbidden_trigger | permissions | secrets | unpinned_action | fork_guard | untrusted_expression; first broken rule wins. stage = size (over 65,536 UTF-8 bytes, before parsing) | parse (yaml.parse threw; yamlCode is the library code, informational) | shape (parsed, but the root/jobs shape is wrong) | rule (a rule rejected it) | ok. texts over 16,384 units are $blob digests (rebuild them from corpus/wfrules/cases.json: the corpus is the source). name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer

on:
  pull_request:
    types:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  review:
    name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Run the DevDigest review
        run: node .devdigest/runner/index.js
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          DEVDIGEST_AGENT: security-reviewer
          DEVDIGEST_POST_AS: github_review
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Upload the review result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: devdigest-result-security-reviewer
          path: devdigest-result.json

name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  review:
    name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    permissions: {}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Run the DevDigest review
        run: node .devdigest/runner/index.js
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          DEVDIGEST_AGENT: security-reviewer
          DEVDIGEST_POST_AS: github_review
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Upload the review result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: devdigest-result-security-reviewer
          path: devdigest-result.json

name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  review:
    name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer
    if: github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Run the DevDigest review
        run: node .devdigest/runner/index.js
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }} and ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          DEVDIGEST_AGENT: security-reviewer
          DEVDIGEST_POST_AS: github_review
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Upload the review result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: devdigest-result-security-reviewer
          path: devdigest-result.json

name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  review:
    name: DevDigest Review · security-reviewer
    if: ${{ ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository }} }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - name: Check out the pull request
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020
        with:
          node-version: '22'

      - name: Run the DevDigest review
        run: node .devdigest/runner/index.js
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          DEVDIGEST_AGENT: security-reviewer
          DEVDIGEST_POST_AS: github_review
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}

      - name: Upload the review result
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: devdigest-result-security-reviewer
          path: devdigest-result.json
